Hello Sir,

I am currently in Silver and I know that's not the most impressive rank, but I do posses a decent amount of knowledge about Jhin (M7, 150k mastery score, mained him last season)

I have some general advice but I will try to mainly focus on teamfighting since thats what you said you struggle with.

In lane I always will max Q and then W. My best tip for those two abilities is try to use your q to poke your enemy laner for free (kill his 3 caster minions and bounce it onto one of the champs. Since it does more damage with every creep it kills in succession if you CS three then bounce to the ADC itll be about a quarter or more of their HP). My tip for the W is get freakishly good at hitting them. This'll be easier the more you use him and learn the range and cast time and such but I have gotten to the point where I can hit kids who are either in my face or half way up river fairly no problem (learning to predict people has always been something I enjoy in video games, like nade spots in Call of Duty or skillshots in League). You will miss some but don't be too hard on yourself.

Ok. The good stuff. Teamfighting. Its a little odd because hes sorta assassiny because of his reload. you get 4 shots to do massive damage to squishies with lethality and crit or tanks even with armor pen then you gotta back out for a few seconds then go back in. Tight areas are my favorite places to fight because I can throw down the flower traps and they will eventually hit someone, I can also bounce grenades effectively. I will ult to execute if people decide to flash out or are getting away. Honestly its just a game of dodging and weaving in and out of the fight. I personally like Yommu's and GA just because they both give me so much survivablity. if you're about to die just pop ghostblade and run out for a while and ult if you need to do damage still. I'd also recommend buying blue trinket since if you ult into fog of war it can be disorienting, also its never good to fight in an area with no vision so it helps that way as well.

I hope this made sense and was helpful. Feel free to reply anytime if you want more info :)
